function.name: Services_1_FindProvider

is_unisex.description: Flag indicating if the salon is unisex. True for unisex, False for gender-specific.

function.name: Weather_1_GetWeather
function.description: Retrieves the weather forecast for a specified city on a certain date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The name of the city for which the weather is being requested, such as 'Los Angeles' or 'New York'.

date.description: The date for which the weather forecast is desired, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not provided, the default is the current date.
